notes: Mistral's current documentation maps mistral-large-latest to Mistral Large 3 (mistral-large-2512), which remains GA and available through Chat Completions and Batch. Standard pricing is $0.50 input, $0.05 cached input, and $1.50 output per 1M tokens. Cached prompt tokens are billed at 10% of standard input, and Batch processing receives a 50% discount, represented in V1 as $0.25 input and $0.75 output. The official docs do not separately specify whether cached-input and Batch discounts combine.
